rationale: Parabacteroides johnsonii is a saccharolytic anaerobe with mixed-acid fermentation. At 8h, I transition to exponential growth using abundant glucose, lactate, and arginine. Nitrogen is limiting (9.3 mM ammonium + arginine nitrogen); uptake of 2.5 mM NH4 + ~0.5 mM N from arginine supports ~0.25/h growth. Carbon balance: 94 mmol C/h uptake → 10.5 (biomass) + 83.5 (fermentation products: acetate, propionate, succinate, CO₂). This is consistent with Bacteroidetes fermentation stoichiometry.
